config.feeRecipientNote: Documentary only — the contract has no on-chain feeRecipient. withdrawFees(token,to) is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE-gated with the destination supplied at call time. This (leaked) EOA was de-privileged 2026-05-17 and cannot withdraw.

auditFixesIncluded: #6 — settleInvoice reverts InvalidPayInToken when relayer-supplied payInToken disagrees with inv.payIn (was silent in the prior bytecode; off-chain accounting could diverge from on-chain log).
#25 — InvoicePaid emit now carries `excess` as the `fee` field instead of hardcoded 0. Indexers and downstream accounting tools see the actual protocol-fee delta.
#26 — Deploy script logs a loud WARN when SUPPORTED_TOKENS is set but deployer != owner (the role-gated setTokenSupport call would otherwise silently no-op).
#27 — withdrawFees gains nonReentrant for consistency with every other fund-moving path. CEI already prevents today's drain; modifier blocks any future fee-on-transfer token surprise.
